versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Competitor YouTube Content Strategy Analyzer.
- Scrapes and analyzes a competitor’s most recent 20–50 YouTube videos for key strategy insights.
- Identifies top video topics, formats, length tiers, and engagement/performance benchmarks.
- Benchmarks video cadence, content mix, and top-performing topics; compares channels if needed.
- Provides detailed output format and troubleshooting steps for various edge cases.
